# Team TS3012 — Pre-Meeting Brief

Based only on the 4 ingested meetings: TS3012a, TS3012b, TS3012c, TS3012d.
Every bullet below carries its own verified transcript quotation.

## A. Decisions Made

- Market: I think we should go for universal, because apparently we're a separate company making separate c remote controls to sell to a lot of diverse people. (confirmed in TS3012b, Speaker A).

- Lost Remote: Yeah, we need to im de we are going to implement the beep and the flash thing to recover your remote. (confirmed in TS3012c, Speaker A).
  > “Yeah, we need to im de we are going to implement the beep and the flash thing to recover your remote.” — TS3012c

- Material: If we choose titanium, uh we cannot use more than one curve. (confirmed in TS3012c, Speaker C).
  > “If we choose titanium, uh we cannot use more than one curve.” — TS3012c

- Colour: Um we agreed that the colour should be b uh yellow and black. (confirmed in TS3012d, Speaker A).
